{{Top|canon=Spirit world}}
[[File:Spirit_World.png|thumb|right|250px|The Spirit World]]
The '''Spirit World''' was an alternate dimension few could access. A number of [[Voss Mystics]] had the ability to enter the world, and a [[Datacron/Legends|datacron]] left on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] allowed those who used it to also access the Spirit World. Typically, as used by the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] Mystics, it could be entered when [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] in front of a dedicated [[meditation tablet]]. One such tablet was located in the [[Lake of the Unseen]] in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on Voss, and many more were placed by the Mystics throughout their [[Shrine of Healing]].
